changelog: **Ending-soon nudge, one-click extend and the below-rhythm signal (#1786, story #1782):** a daily `reminders.relationEnding` job (09:00 batch; `/api/cron?job=relation-ending`) gives every live, unpaused pairing whose `expectedEndDate` falls inside the programme → org setting `relationEndingLeadDays` (default 14) ONE ending-soon notice + mail to both participants in their own language, claimed by a guarded update of `endingSoonNotifiedAt` before anyone is told (mail category `relation-ending`, dedupe key per recipient and end date). Never a second chase, never an automatic closure or extension. `POST /api/mentorship/[id]/extend` (ADMIN or the relation's mentor; a mentee gets 403) and the mentor's signed one-click mail link (`/m/<token>`, new `extend` email-action kind bound to the announced end date, so a replay is refused as `stale`) both go through `extendRelation()` (`src/lib/relationExtend.ts`): moves the date later, `durationExtendedCount + 1`, clears the stamp, writes a `RelationLifecycleEvent` (reason `extended`, state unchanged), raises `mentorship.extended` and tells the mentee. New public webhook events `mentorship.ending_soon` and `mentorship.extended`. The mentor attention queue gains `behind_cadence` — the gap since the pair last met exceeds 1.5 × the agreed `expectedMeetingIntervalWeeks`; a pair with no agreed rhythm shows nothing. Rules pure in `src/lib/relationEnding.ts` (unit-tested); docs/relation-ending.md.

en: Two weeks before a pairing's agreed end date, both sides get one reminder to plan the wrap-up — and the mentor can extend it with one click, right from the e-mail.
Your attention list now flags pairs that meet less often than they agreed.
tr: Bir eşleşmenin anlaşılan bitiş tarihinden iki hafta önce iki taraf da kapanışı planlamak için tek bir hatırlatma alıyor — mentor da e-postadan tek tıkla uzatabiliyor.
Dikkat listeniz artık anlaşılandan seyrek görüşen eşleşmeleri gösteriyor.
de: Zwei Wochen vor dem vereinbarten Ende einer Paarung bekommen beide Seiten eine Erinnerung, den Abschluss zu planen — und der Mentor kann sie mit einem Klick direkt aus der E-Mail verlängern.
Deine Aufmerksamkeitsliste zeigt jetzt Paarungen, die sich seltener treffen als vereinbart.
